# Lisbon Press Trip — Early Planning Notes
_Created during initial scoping, before contract finalized_

## Trip Basics
- Dates: May 12–19, 2026 (7 nights)
- Partner: Visit Lisbon (via Marco Ferreira)
- Status at time of writing: verbal confirmation, contract pending

## Anticipated Deliverables (pre-contract draft)
- 2 x Instagram Reels — likely 30–45 sec, destination highlights
- 1 x Blog post — aiming for 1,200–1,500 words, SEO-focused on 'best neighborhoods in Lisbon'
- 3 x Instagram Feed Photos — one per neighborhood (Alfama, Belém, one TBD)
- Deadline: probably end of May or early June — TBD once contract arrives

## Content Angles to Explore
- Alfama fado scene at dusk
- Belém pastéis de nata + Jerónimos Monastery
- LX Factory Sunday market
- Tram 28 route
- Sintra day trip if itinerary allows

## Notes
- No Stories requirement discussed yet — may come up in contract
- Shot list not confirmed — waiting on Marco
- Budget for props/styling: check with accountant re: trip expense deductions

## Open Questions
- Will they provide a shot list or leave creative direction to me?
- Any exclusivity clause on Lisbon content post-trip?
- Portal submission process — need login credentials from Marco

title: Lisbon Trip — On-Road Content Schedule Draft
content:
# Lisbon On-Road Content Schedule — Draft
_Working draft for packing and shoot planning_

## Day-by-Day Shoot Plan

**May 12 (Arrival)** — Check-in, golden hour walk near hotel, grab 1–2 ambient feed shots
**May 13** — Alfama morning shoot (Reel #1 candidate), fado dinner (hosted)
**May 14** — Belém: Jerónimos + pastéis de nata (feed photo + Reel B-roll)
**May 15** — Sintra day trip (coach 09:00) — landscape shots, feed photo
**May 16** — LX Factory + Mouraria (feed photos, Reel #2 candidate), hosted dinner
**May 17** — Buffer day: re-shoots, blog notes, interview any local contacts
**May 18** — Final walk, pack, review footage
**May 19** — Departure

## Deliverable Tracker (working)
- Reel #1: Alfama — target May 13 shoot
- Reel #2: LX Factory/Mouraria — target May 16 shoot
- Blog post: draft on May 17, publish within 2 weeks of return
- Feed photos: 3 minimum (Alfama, Belém, Sintra) — may expand

## Gear Checklist
- Sony A7IV + 24-70mm
- DJI Osmo Pocket 3 (Reels)
- Rode Wireless GO II
- ND filters
- Portable charger x2

## Notes
- This schedule predates final contract — deliverable counts may change
- No Stories planned yet in this draft
